name: ts-optimize
description: Audit TypeScript for dead code, AI slop, weak types and tsgo readiness; write reviewable findings; fix them under a verified, traceable gate. Silent in repos without TypeScript.

interface.longDescription: Audit a TypeScript codebase for dead code, unused dependencies, AI slop, weak types and tsgo readiness. Findings are written to .ts-optimize/ as reviewable files; fixes run wave by wave under a typecheck, test and build gate with a traceable commit per change. Silent in repos without TypeScript.
